name: Low Carb Taco Cabbage Beef Skillet

fit.note: 576 cal sits mid-band (400-650) and 11g carb clears the 35g ceiling with deep margin; ground beef seared with shredded cabbage as the vegetable base, no rice/pasta/potato; single skillet weigh-and-divide to 14. FIT on published source macros.

dupe_evidence: No catalog match. Catalog taco/tex-mex beef skillets are all rice-based (loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls, tex-mex-beef-rice-skillet-bowls, arroz-con-carne-molida) - loaded-beef-taco-skillet-bowls shares protein+taco flavor+skillet but is a loaded RICE bowl with beans/corn/zucchini, a genuinely different plate from this simple beef+cabbage+cheese cabbage skillet. unstuffed-cabbage-roll-bowls pairs beef+cabbage but is cabbage-roll tomato flavor over rice, not taco and not low-carb.

pool_collisions.note: Both are a low-carb beef taco skillet differing only in the low-carb vegetable base (cabbage here vs cauliflower there); same protein + taco flavor + skillet method. Decider should keep ONE. This cabbage version has a far deeper carb margin (11g vs beef-cauliflower-taco-skillet's 34g, which sits only 1g under the ceiling) and cabbage is the cheaper board item.
Shares beef+cabbage+skillet but Mediterranean flavor family, not taco - different dinner.

cross_protein_twins.note: Structurally the same dish in ground turkey (taco-seasoned turkey skillet) - decider verify against turkey pool.
Turkey + cabbage skillet; if that one is taco-flavored it is a cross-protein twin of this dish.
